findings.evidence: The active design.md decision 4 explicitly requires nesting across finish → select_checks → run_test_groups. However, template/scripts/post_review_finalization.py:133-134 starts selected checks without pass_fds; template/scripts/openspec_lifecycle.py:524 likewise omits pass_fds when invoking selected checks for archive. When invoked inside a pooled run, these subprocesses inherit DEV_PLATFORM_MACHINE_POOL_LEASE but subprocess.run closes the referenced descriptors. template/scripts/machine_pool.py:614-625 and 640-644 then reject the nested acquisition with 'pooled lease is missing inherited descriptor(s)'. This contradicts the active spec requirement that nested runs reuse the parent lease.
findings.summary: Nested lifecycle execution propagates the lease environment but drops its descriptors, causing selected checks to fail instead of reusing the parent lease.
